project.name: Understand-Anything
project.description: AI-powered codebase understanding plugin with deterministic Python analysis, bundled skills, agent prompts, packaging scripts, and dashboard assets. Note: this project has over 100 source files; consider scoping analysis to a subdirectory for faster results.

nodes.name: Analysis Pipeline
nodes.summary: Deterministic codebase scanning, import extraction, batching, graph assembly, validation, persistence, and fingerprinting workflows.

nodes.name: Build Knowledge Graph
nodes.summary: Turns repository files into a validated structural knowledge graph for the dashboard and chat tools.

nodes.name: Scan Project
nodes.summary: Enumerate files, apply ignore rules, detect languages and categories, and estimate project complexity.

nodes.name: Extract and Merge Structure
nodes.summary: Extract per-file structure, seed graph fragments, finalize batch outputs, and merge them into one assembled graph.

nodes.name: Validate and Save Graph
nodes.summary: Validate the assembled graph, save knowledge-graph.json, build fingerprints, and write metadata.

nodes.name: Skill Runtime
nodes.summary: Codex-facing skills, scripts, prompts, hooks, and agent prompt contracts used to operate the analysis workflow.

nodes.name: Run Understand Skill
nodes.summary: Coordinates preflight, project context capture, analysis phases, architecture grouping, review, save, and domain graph generation.

nodes.name: Preflight and Context
nodes.summary: Resolve project roots, initialize the Python environment, prepare workspace directories, and capture repository context.

nodes.name: Dispatch or Run Phases
nodes.summary: Runs deterministic phases and, when available, delegates semantic scan, file, architecture, review, and domain analysis phases.

nodes.name: Dashboard Experience
nodes.summary: React/Vite dashboard and local server surfaces that visualize structural and domain graphs for interactive exploration.

nodes.name: Explore Graph
nodes.summary: Loads saved graph artifacts and presents structural layers, relationships, search, and domain views to users.

nodes.name: Load Graph Artifacts
nodes.summary: Read knowledge-graph.json and domain-graph.json artifacts from the analyzed repository.

nodes.name: Render Graph Views
nodes.summary: Render graph nodes, edges, layers, details, and domain flows in the dashboard UI.

nodes.name: Distribution
nodes.summary: Installer, packaging, plugin metadata, local payload layout, and command wrapper surfaces that ship the Understand-Anything plugin.

nodes.name: Install Plugin
nodes.summary: Builds and installs the plugin payload, command wrappers, skills, hooks, and package assets into target agent environments.

nodes.name: Build Payload
nodes.summary: Collect source packages, skills, agents, hooks, tools, dashboard assets, and plugin metadata into a distributable payload.

nodes.name: Link Agent Surfaces
nodes.summary: Expose installed skills, hooks, and command wrappers through the target local agent integration paths.
